blocks.text:
Operation in which one captor was killed brings to an end day-long siege in which 30 hostages were initially held

Colombian security forces have stormed a supermarket in the Caribbean city of Cartagena, ending a day-long hostage siege, with the president saying all of those held have been rescued and one captor killed.

Several explosions were heard before security forces entered the building, where about 20 people were believed to be being held by armed men.
